# scrcpy-fedora

> Fedora RPM packaging experiments for scrcpy.

The repository contains a Fedora SPEC file and build automation for scrcpy RPMs. The documented build uses RPM Fusion and OpenH264 repositories and can run through GitHub Actions and Copr.

## Repository overview

- [Source repository](https://github.com/useidel/scrcpy-fedora): Canonical GitHub repository, including source files, issues, history, and repository metadata.
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/useidel/scrcpy-fedora/HEAD/README.md): Primary project documentation and usage notes.
